newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets chief aide, health report due soon.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets chief aide, health report due soon.

text.p: Kremlin chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais met Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday at the hospital where the president is being treated for pneumonia, a presidential spokesman said.

He told Reuters the Kremlin press office expected to issue a bulletin on Yeltsin's health by around 8 p.m. (1700 GMT). Spokesmen had said previously his doctors were to meet at 5 p.m. (1400 GMT) and issue a statement on his health after that.
Interfax news agency said Yeltsin met Chubais for more than half an hour and discussed regional elections, personnel matters and other issues of state.

Itar-Tass news agency said it was the 65-year-old president's first working meeting since being taken into Moscow's elite Central Clinical Hospital last Wednesday, just two weeks after returning to work at the Kremlin following his heart bypass operation on November 5.
His absence has sparked calls from his opponents to step down.
